summary: Lipocine Inc. filed an 8-K on May 18, 2026, announcing it will present at A.G.P.'s Annual Virtual Healthcare Company Showcase on May 20, 2026. The filing includes a press release with details of the fireside chat and a company overview of its biopharmaceutical pipeline. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situations events are discussed. This is a routine investor-relations announcement, furnishing a press release under Item 8.01. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are present. The filing is purely informational and does not constitute a special situation.
